title: Art Education, B.S. (College of Arts and Architecture)
notes: New catalogs created: aed_catalog.json (entire AED department), art_catalog.json (ART 11/110/111/122Y), aplng_catalog.json (APLNG 200/210). Real gap fixed: AED 489 requires AED 490 as an enforced concurrent, but the bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan never schedules AED 490 anywhere -- added it as an explicit companion item alongside AED 489 in Semester 7. Real engine-mechanics gap (same pattern as Architecture B.Arch's ARCH 121/131 pairs): AED 495A/495B and AED 495C/495D are each listed as mutual corequisites of each other -- broken into one-directional edges since the engine's same-term scheduling can't resolve true mutual concurrency; both pairs are still scheduled together in the same semester regardless. Picked the AED 495A/495B (PK-4/elementary) student-teaching pair over AED 495C/495D (secondary) since the bulletin's own suggested plan lists 'AED 495A or 495C' / 'AED 495B or 495D' without preferring one, and elementary is the more common track. 'Additional Course for Major' (12cr, beginning-level art/digital/photo pool), 'Supporting Course: 300/400-level Art History' (6cr), and 'Supporting Course: 300/400-level studio art' (8cr) are modeled generically, same convention as CMPSC's own open pools -- unlike Art B.A./B.F.A. (blocked in BLOCKED_MAJORS.md), Art Education's own program requirements don't gate these pools behind an unresolvable concentration choice. 2026-08-27 re-verification: no separate School of Visual Arts undergraduate handbook found beyond the bulletin (only a Ph.D./graduate Art Education handbook exists at sites.psu.edu/aedgrad, not applicable to this B.S.) -- verified against the CURRENT live bulletin's own 'Suggested Academic Plan' tab HTML instead, which is far more granular than the top-level program page: it names a real, closed 'Additional Courses' list (footnote 1: 12cr from DART 202/206, ART 211/220/223/230/240/250/260/280/296/297/299, PHOTO 100/101/200/201/202, all at the 'beginning level') and a real 'Supporting Courses and Related Areas' split (footnote 3: 8cr in ART/DART/PHOTO at the 300/400 level, 6cr in Art History at the 300/400 level). Added DART and PHOTO to `departments` (previously missing, even though the bulletin's own Additional Courses list names them) and: (1) wired all 4 'Additional Course for Major' slots to that real 19-code list instead of leaving them fully generic; (2) wired both 'Supporting Course: 300/400-level Art History' slots to `open_elective` with `elective_min_level: 300` and every other loaded department excluded, so only a real 300+-level ARTH course is ever recommended; (3) wired both 'Supporting Course: 300/400-level studio art' slots the same way, restricted to ART/DART/PHOTO only. All other required courses, the Entrance-to-Major criteria, and the AED 495A/B student-teaching pair cross-checked clean against the live bulletin -- no other drift found.
